findings.message: AC-9 and T1 say the page uses the `Mascot` from `packages/ui`, and the 062 mock puts the mascot on the video card. The page never uses it: the only `@amax/ui` import is `Logo`, in MarketingBar.tsx. Either add `Mascot` to the hero or video card, or drop it from AC-9 and the verify record.
findings.scenario: Open /welcome → no mascot appears anywhere, but the verify record says AC-9 passes with `Logo` and `Mascot`.

findings.message: AC-10 requires Playwright to check that a signed-out visitor at `/` sees no rail, top bar, search, chat launcher or profile. The test at `/` only checks that the Main nav is absent. The search, chat launcher and profile checks exist only in marketing.spec.ts, which loads /welcome directly and never goes through the proxy rewrite. Add those checks to the signed-out `/` part of landing.spec.ts.
findings.scenario: A change that puts the chat launcher in the root layout shows it on the rewritten `/` → landing.spec still passes.

findings.message: Only the unset case of AMAX_SALES_EMAIL is tested: the Book a demo links are hidden. Nothing renders the page with an address set and checks the `mailto:` href and its encoded subject, but the verify record cites e2e for that case. Add a unit render of Hero/MarketingBar/Closing (or DemoLink) with an email set.
findings.scenario: DemoLink builds a wrong href (say, a missing `mailto:`) → every test stays green, because every run has the variable unset.

findings.message: The 062 mock section and the shipped page disagree. The mock always shows Book a demo, but the page hides it when AMAX_SALES_EMAIL is unset and shows Sign in in the closing section instead. The mock's chat preview has a Confirm `<button>`, which the page leaves out. The mock caption says 'Kasun pushes a commit', but the captions file says 'You push a commit.' Bring the mock in line with the page.

[design] The 'commits log time' claim was a major in earlier rounds. Time from a commit is only a `time.commit-draft` suggestion until the person accepts it. The hero, description, Problem card, captions and mock were fixed to say agents 'draft' the time. In the final diff no test guards that fix any more. The earlier `TIME` check is gone from marketing-confirm.test.ts, and nothing in apps/web/tests matches log/logs time, timesheet or bookkeeping wording. marketing-areas.test.ts only looks for the words of Coming features, and marketing-confirm only checks confirm claims. Fix: bring back a table-driven check over `surfaces()`. Any sentence about time or hours (log, logs, logged, record, track, fill in the timesheet, bookkeeping) must also say it is drafted or suggested and that the person accepts it. Add a rejects table with at least 'Commits close tasks and log time.', 'Agents log time.' and 'In amax, agents fill in the timesheet over MCP.'
findings.scenario: Change HERO_LEDE back to "Commits close tasks and log time.", or the VTT cue back to "And logs the time for the person it acted for" → pnpm test stays green, and the public page again claims hours are logged with no one accepting them.
